001package pkg_entities;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004
005/**
006 * Represents a trainer who can appear in a room and battle the player.
007 *
008 * <p>Each trainer owns a numbered Pokemon team and keeps track of whether the player has already
009 * defeated them.
010 *
011 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
012 * @version 2026.05.08
013 */
014public class Trainer {
015    /** Trainer name used as a key in room trainer lists. */
016    private String aName;
017
018    /** Narrative description shown in room listings. */
019    private String aDialog;
020
021    /** Pokemon team indexed from one for battle order. */
022    private HashMap<Integer, Pokemon> aTeam;
023
024    /** Whether this trainer has been defeated by the player. */
025    private boolean aIsDefeated;
026
027    /**
028     * Creates a trainer with a display name and room description.
029     *
030     * @param pName the trainer name
031     * @param pDialog the description shown when the trainer is in a room
032     */
033    public Trainer(final String pName, final String pDialog) {
034        this.aName = pName;
035        this.aDialog = pDialog;
036        this.aTeam = new HashMap<>();
037        this.aIsDefeated = false;
038    } // Trainer()
039
040    /**
041     * Returns the trainer name.
042     *
043     * @return the trainer name
044     */
045    public String getName() {
046        return this.aName;
047    } // getName()
048
049    /**
050     * Indicates whether this trainer has already been defeated.
051     *
052     * @return {@code true} when the player has defeated this trainer
053     */
054    public boolean isDefeated() {
055        return this.aIsDefeated;
056    } // isDefeated()
057
058    /**
059     * Sets this trainer's defeated state.
060     *
061     * @param pDefeated {@code true} after the trainer loses a battle
062     */
063    public void setDefeated(final boolean pDefeated) {
064        this.aIsDefeated = pDefeated;
065    } // setDefeated()
066
067    /**
068     * Returns the number of Pokemon in this trainer's team.
069     *
070     * @return the configured team size
071     */
072    public int getTeamSize() {
073        return this.aTeam.size();
074    } // getTeamSize()
075
076    /**
077     * Adds or replaces a Pokemon at the given team position.
078     *
079     * @param pPosition the team slot
080     * @param pPokemon the Pokemon to store
081     */
082    public void setPokemon(final Integer pPosition, final Pokemon pPokemon) {
083        this.aTeam.put(pPosition, pPokemon);
084    } // setPokemon()
085
086    /**
087     * Returns the Pokemon in the given team slot.
088     *
089     * @param pPosition the team slot
090     * @return the matching Pokemon, or {@code null}
091     */
092    public Pokemon getPokemon(final Integer pPosition) {
093        return this.aTeam.get(pPosition);
094    } // getPokemon()
095
096    /**
097     * Builds a short multi-line summary combining description and team size.
098     *
099     * @return two-line English text suitable for room descriptions
100     */
101    public String getTrainerDescription() {
102        String vDefeatedText;
103        if (this.isDefeated()) {
104            vDefeatedText = " (defeated)";
105        } else {
106            vDefeatedText = "";
107        }
108        return this.aDialog + vDefeatedText + '\n' + "Team size: " + this.aTeam.size();
109    } // getTrainerDescription()
110}
